label: MCXN947 HVAC Monitor — MCSA (MooreVIEW Parc MQTT)

telemetrySchema.mcsa: Array of per-CT cooked diagnostic spectra. Each channel has fund [Hz,amp], rotor/bearing/ecc [[Hz,amp],...], optional load groups (fan/pump/compressor/turbine), and stator [Hz,amp].

notes: Firmware publishes MooreVIEW Parc v1 telemetry to mooreview/v1/hvac_mcsa_01/telemetry (~1 Hz). Payload carries MCSA cooked freq/amplitude pairs from FFT diagnostic bins (not severity scalars). Env sensors: T1_C..T4_C, WATER_ROPE_MV, WR_DETECT. Recommended tags[] row for MooreVIEW ingest: T1_C, T2_C, COMP_FLT, FAN_FLT (see st/fixtures/hvac-mcsa-telemetry-sample.json). Enable MQTT Parc hub in MooreVIEW with the same broker. Set MV_DEVICE_ID and MV_BROKER_ADDR in src/mcsa_mqtt.h to match.
